name: Item tile
layerWhy: It shows one item with its payload named and kept, a whole job of presenting a thing in a collection.
promise: The one thing this tile exists to show stays, whatever the width.
expectation: A card with its state, its title, and metadata that gives way.
evidence: At 320px with real-length data the title is shown in full; in a narrow tile the number, labels and assignee give way first.
context: Issues, tasks, products in a board or grid.
relationships: A status, badges and an avatar around the payload.
failures: Never cuts the payload while metadata survives.
do: Mark everything but the payload data-gives-way.
dont: Truncating the title with an ellipsis.
